capabilities: Edit note content as a mind map with changes synced both ways to the Markdown file
Drag and drop nodes to change parents, updating heading levels in the note
Collapse and expand nodes in sync with folding in the note
Copy branches as Markdown or the whole note as a Mermaid mindmap block
Search, zoom, and apply automatic layouts (tidy tree, center root, radial)
extras: Privacy note: embedded images and videos with http(s) addresses are downloaded from the remote server when their node is shown. The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no way to view or restructure a note's outline as a mind map while keeping the Markdown file as the only source of content.
summary: Mind map editor that opens a note as a map of headings, list items and paragraphs, with two-way sync to the Markdown file.
